items.preserved_text: W01 keeps the origin of three generations unresolved and treats S7/unit-octonion/Spin(8)/G2 possibilities as speculation rather than established structure.

W01 speculates that the 4x4-complex-matrix generation construction may be a lift of the Clifford-algebra bundle and contrasts it with Kogut-Susskind multiplicity; this is not established PT structure.
W03 records Euclidean-twistor, right-handed-spacetime, and July-2026 Wick-rotation/chiral-field stages as revisions rather than one timeless formulation.
W04c explicitly revises the Euclidean-first program into a Minkowski-twistor/holomorphic-first viewpoint and treats Euclidean geometry as a chosen realization.
W04d requires extra quaternionic/fibration structure for a Euclidean realization and leaves the exact new spinor/twistor Wick-rotation implementation unresolved.
W05 compares the Fargues-Fontaine curve and twistor P1 while explicitly warning that the comparison is only an analogy.
W05 speculates that recurrence of twistor P1 across domains may indicate a deeper relation but explicitly allows that it may have no fundamental significance.
W01's suggested lift would give sixteen Weyl-spinor copies with the Weyl degree of freedom supplied by the CP1 fiber; the source marks this as speculative.
W01 concludes the framework is chiral in gravity and electroweak sectors and leaves observable consequences open; this is not an established prediction.
